corrections.text: The article says 83% of the actions that targeted a bug ID were unprompted. The Google post's wording is "Over 4 in 5 of those actions (83% sessions)", so it describes the same 83% as actions and, in its parenthetical, as sessions; neither the post nor InfoQ clarifies which unit is meant.

The article says unprompted detours made "the affected sessions" longer and costlier, with 70% more steps, 77% more tokens and 105% more wait time. The Google post says only "Per session" and does not state what these increases are measured against (for example, sessions without such a detour); the article notes the missing baseline counts but not this missing comparison group.
